chapters.title: Customer and Vendor Receivables and Payables

features.name: GP Snapshot feature
features.description: Capability to bring over transactional information from GP into Business Central in extension tables, allowing historical data to be viewed in list pages within Business Central.
caveats: Data is stored in extension tables
Must be configured through cloud migration wizard

features.name: GP Company Migration Configuration page
features.description: Configuration interface accessed through the cloud migration wizard or cloud migration management page where users can select module transactions and set the date range for historical snapshot data migration.
caveats: Must complete configuration before migration begins

features.name: Historical Snapshot module selection
features.description: Feature allowing users to select specific module transactions to migrate and configure how far back the transactional data should be brought over, with flexibility to set different date ranges than the GL summary.
caveats: Default year is based on GL summary setting but can be customized

features.name: Automatic snapshot processing
features.description: The GP snapshot runs automatically once the cloud migration is complete, with progress that can be monitored through tiles in the cloud migration management page.

features.name: GP Detail Snapshot for GL accounts
features.description: Navigable option under chart of accounts showing GL detail information migrated from GP 20,000 and 30,000 tables, with data organized by account number or displayed as all detail transactions.
caveats: Data comes from GP 20,000 and 30,000 tables

features.name: GL snapshot data export and filtering
features.description: Ability to export GL snapshot data to Excel, filter on specific values, and search for journal entry numbers with automatic page filtering and drill-through capability to subledger transactions.

features.name: Customer GP Detail Snapshot
features.description: Option available on the customer list showing receivables and sales order processing transactions with ability to filter by specific customer and drill back to see transaction details including payments applied.

features.name: Vendor GP Detail Snapshot
features.description: Snapshot option for vendors showing payables information and purchase receiving transactions with the ability to view all vendors or filter by specific vendor selection.

features.name: Item GP Detail Snapshot
features.description: Snapshot information for inventory transactions brought over from GP, accessible under the items navigation without tile filtering options.
caveats: No tiles available for item list navigation

quotes.text: the GP snapshot allows you to bring over transactional information from GP into business Central in extension tables
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core capability and data storage mechanism of the GP snapshot feature

quotes.text: you can indicate what module transactions you would like migrated to business Central once you select the module transactions you can indicate how far

quotes.text: you may want to bring over the last 3 years of GL summary inform information but maybe you want to go back seven years

quotes.text: The GP snapshot will run automatically once the migration is complete you can monitor the progress of the snapshot by looking at the tiles
quotes.why_it_matters: Confirms automatic execution of snapshot and provides visibility mechanism through cloud migration management interface

quotes.text: this information comes from the GP 20,000 and 30,000 tables so that is the detailed tables in GP for both your open and history

quotes.text: like any list page in business Central you can export this information out to excel you can also filter on it and search for
quotes.why_it_matters: Shows that snapshot data integrates with standard Business Central list page capabilities for analysis and export

quotes.text: if the transaction came from a subledger you can drill back on that journal entry number to see that subledger transactions
